q: How do I count latex and backing cloth in a tufted carpet footprint?
title: Tufted carpet: latex and backing
short: Latex compound and backing cloth are purchased materials, so they go in Scope 3 Category 1 for your company and in the cradle to gate figure per square metre. Multiply kg used per square metre by a supplier or published factor for each material, and add the energy of the curing oven.
audience: Hand tufted and machine tufted carpet makers in Bhadohi and Panipat

ul: Latex: synthetic SBR or natural rubber, with different factors.
Primary and secondary backing: cotton, jute or polypropylene.
Filler such as chalk in the compound.

p: Gas, diesel or wood burned in the drying and curing stage, per square metre, from fuel invoices and production logs.
Ask the latex and cloth suppliers first; use a published average only when they cannot answer, and label it.

senseible: Senseible reads purchase invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record, so each supplier figure in your Scope 3 sits next to the quantity and the document it applies to.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
